title: Glory
summary:
Glory is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language sports thriller television series written and directed by Karan Anshuman and Kanishk Varma for Netflix. The series is produced by Karan Anshuman and Mohit Shah of Atomic Films. It stars Divyenndu, Pulkit Samrat and Suvinder Vicky as pivotal role.
The series was filmed mostly across Haryana. John Schmidt served as the cinematographer of the series. John Stewart Eduri composed the background score. 
The first season of Glory was released on 1 May 2026.
plot: In a small-town boxing hub, two brothers investigate a shocking murder while navigating a troubled reunion with their father, a renowned coach.
reception:
Anuj Kumar for The Hindu stated the series "a cohesive whole for viewers attuned to logical consistency and tonal balance."
Shubhra Gupta of The Indian Express rated the series 2/5 stars and raised concern about violence shown stating "Animals aren’t spared either."
Joel Keller of Decider stated the series as "it’s a pretty dark and violent story." Bhavna Agarwal of India Today wrote "The idea is strong: use a whodunit to peel back emotional layers. And initially, it works."
Suchin Mehrotra of The Hollywood Reporter India stated "shamelessly pulpy crime drama in recent memory — emotionally potent, generically promiscuous, and rich with festering old wounds." Udita Jhunjhunwala for Scroll.in felt the violence is extreme." BH Harsh of Cinema Express praised Divyenndu's performance and wrote "Divyenndu delivers a stellar performance."
Abhimanyu Mathur Hindustan Times stated "Glory is a good example of ‘what could have been’, which has been the story of Indian OTT since the pandemic." Bollywood Hungama rated the series 3 stars in their review.
Shachi Chaturvedi from News18 stated "the narrative could have benefited from tighter storytelling."

title: Thai Maaman
summary:
Thai Maaman or Thai Maaman - Thaikku Nigaranavan (transl. Maternal uncle) is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language Melodrama romantic television series that airs on Star Vijay starring Ranjith, Devipriya, Raj Kapoor, Seema G. Nair, Sastik and Shiyara Shalini
. Directed by Manoj Kumar, written and Screenplay by Chandru Dhuraiyappan, the serial revolves around the journey of a touching sentimental story between a brother and a sister.
The show was produced by Jagan Baskaran under the Box Office Studio banner. It premiered on Star Vijay on 27 April 2026, and airs from Monday to Friday at 19:00 and streams digitally on JioHotstar.
plot:
The series focuses on the relationship between Mayandi, a respected landlord in the village of Rasingapuram in Theni district of Tamil Nadu, and his younger sister Pechi, who is married to Manjamalai of the neighbouring village Nagalapuram.
Mayandi and Pechi have a strong bond and always look out for each other. While the two families were initially close, circumstances lead to a fight between Mayandi and Manjamalai during the ear piercing ceremony of Manjamalai and Pechi's third daughter Ilavarasi, leading to the death of Manjamalai's father at the hands of Sudalai, Manjamalai's wastrel and drunkard brother-in-law, who then puts the blame on Mayandi. This, along with Mayandi accidentally cutting off Manjamalai's hand during their fight, leads to Mayandi getting sentenced to fourteen years of imprisonment, shattering his family and beginning the life-long enmity between the two families, with Pechi, who is aware of her brother's innocence and refuses to condemn him, caught in between the feud. Mayandi's wife Meenatchi distances the family from Pechi's family and focuses on tending her husband's land while he is in prison, eventually becoming rich due to her hard work. On the other hand, Manjamalai becomes more influenced by Sudalai and, distraught due to losing his hand, becomes an unemployed drunkard and his family begins to face the hard times.
Ten years later, Mayandi is released from prison earlier than expected due to good conduct and returns home to witness the feud personally. The feud has extended to the next generation, with Mayandi and Meenatchi's son Azhagar and Manjamalai and Pechi's eldest daughter Poongodi (who were both close in their childhood) hating each other and blaming each other's fathers as the cause of their conflict and engage in practical jokes and verbal banter most of the time. Azhagar is in love with Nandhini, who is the daughter of Deivanai, Meenatchi's sister-in-law. The conflict takes a drastic turn during Poongodi's puberty ceremony, which is held later than usual due to her poor health when she is menstruating. Manjamalai, who reluctantly, on Sudalai's request, invites Mayandi and his family to the ceremony only to seize Mayandi's properties, becomes infuriated when Mayandi asks for Poongodi to marry Azhagar in exchange for the properties. Manjamalai insults Azhagar's parentage and challenges Mayandi and Azhagar that he would get Poongodi married to another person within a week. Poongodi's marriage is arranged with a middle-aged bar owner named Pandi. On the night before the wedding, Azhagar, to get back at Manjamalai for his cruel words on his parentage that shattered Meenatchi and vowing to stop the marriage at any cost, kidnaps Poongodi and keeps her safely in an abandoned cinema theatre until the Muhurtham (auspicious time for marriage) is over. Once he has won in his challenge i.e. ensuring that the wedding does not take place, he personally takes Poongodi back home. At this juncture, Poongodi and Manjamalai hatch a plan to humiliate Azhagar and his family due to the humiliation faced by Manjamalai on the marriage not taking place. As part of this plan, Poongodi forces Azhagar to marry her in front of the Rasingapuram panchayat and then enter his home to expose and humiliate Azhagar, Mayandi and their family members and show that they are not good people as they claim to be.
The rest of the story revolves on whether Poongodi and Manjamalai succeed in their mission, whether Poongodi and Azhagar accept each other despite the circumstances, whether the brother-sister bond of Mayandi and Pechi can continue to hold and whether the two families would ever reconcile.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
Thai Maaman was produced by Jagan Baskaran under the banner of Box Office Studio, known for his series like Thendral Vandhu Ennai Thodum (2021-2023), Kaatrukkenna Veli (2021-2023) and Chellamma (2022-2024). The series is directed by Manoj Kumar, known for his series like Mouna Raagam (2017-2023) and Chinna Marumagal and written by Chandru Dhuraiyappan.
The concept of the show was originally based on Bharathiraja's 1993 film Kizhakku Cheemayile.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Tamil film actor, Ranjith was cast as Mayandi, marking his return after Bigg Boss 8. Actress Devipriya plays the role of Mayandi's sister Pechi. Raj Kapoor played the role of Pechi's husband, Seema G. Nair played the role of Mayandi's wife.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text:
Star Vijay released the series' first promo on 5 April 2026 featuring all the main cast. The second and third promos were released on 13 April and 17 April 2026. On 22 April, revealing the upcoming release date.
The show debuted on Star Vijay on 27 April 2026 from Monday to Friday at 19:00, taking Sindhu Bairavi Kacheri Arambam 's time slot.

title: Jerax
summary: Jerax is a 2026 Indian Kannada-language fantasy comedy-thriller television miniseries written and directed by Srinidhi Bengaluru. Produced by Dhananjaya under the Daali Pictures banner, the series stars Nagabhushana NS in the lead role. It is scheduled to premiere on ZEE5 on 24 April 2026.
plot: The series follows Prakasha, a modest xerox shop employee in the town of Malavalli. His life takes a supernatural turn when his photocopying machine gains the ability to create living duplicates, human clones that possess the memories and traits of the originals. The narrative explores the social and personal chaos that ensues as multiple versions of the town's residents begin to coexist.
reception:
The series received mixed reviews from critics, who praised the performances and concept but criticized the execution and pacing.
Vivek M.V. of The Hindu gave the series a positive review, describing it as "a witty fantasy drama propelled by fine performances." Anandu Suresh, writing for The Indian Express, noted that the lead actors "Nagabhushana [and] Payal Chengappa lead a simple fantasy comedy series that fumbles along the way."
Other reviewers were more critical of the show's pacing. India Today rated the series 2 out of 5 stars, stating that while the show features an "innovative concept", it ultimately represents a "wasted opportunity." Similarly, Susmita Sameera of The Times of India also awarded the series 2 out of 5 stars, concluding that it is "a unique concept that struggles to sustain engagement."

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The series marks the directorial debut in the digital space for Srinidhi Bengaluru, who previously directed the critically acclaimed science-fiction film Blink (2024). Actor Dhananjaya produced the series under his home banner, Daali Pictures, marking his first venture into OTT production.

title: Must Date the Playboy
summary:
Must Date the Playboy  is a 2026 Singaporean Tamil-language Coming-of-age romantic drama television series directed by T. Suriavelan, starring Chandini Nagadurga and Muzammil Elias in the lead, with Ganga Kannan, Mazhaimegan and Pragadesh s/o Prakash in other pivotal roles. Based on the Philippines novel of the same name written by Imma Delos Santos, the story follows Tara, who enters a fake relationship with the college's notorious heartbreaker, Zayn, in a desperate bid to protect her best friend, from his pursuit. However, her strategic plan backfires as real feelings begin to blur the lines of their game, forcing both Tara and Zayn into a vulnerable emotional battlefield where they risk genuinely falling for each other.
The show was produced by Satesh Kumaran and Priya Ramesh under the 360 Entertainment Productions banner. It premiered on Mediacorp Vasantham on 22 April 2026, and airs from Monday to Thursday at 22:00 and streams digitally on mewatch.
plot:
The story begins in the sprawling, bustling campus of a prestigious college, where Vaishnavi Tara Priyadharshan "Tara" is known as the ultimate nerd—brilliant, focused, and intensely private. Despite coming from an incredibly wealthy background, she completely shuns the flashy, high-profile lifestyle her family's money could afford, choosing instead to bury herself in her studies, oversized sweaters, and thick textbooks. Tara’s safe haven in this chaotic university environment is her tight-knit friendship with Kaushika and Nithin. The three of them are inseparable, sharing a bond built on mutual support, quiet study sessions, and a shared desire to navigate their degrees without unnecessary drama. Tara relies heavily on Kaushika’s protective nature and Nithin’s grounded, steady presence to keep her anchored, unaware that the ghosts of her friends' pasts are about to collide violently with her peaceful academic life.
Unbeknownst to Tara, a complex web of history already connects her friends to the college’s most notorious social circle. Years ago, during their school days, Kaushika, Nithin, Zayn, and Jegan were all part of the same classmate circle. However, as time passed, a sharp rift formed. Zayn Ishaan Aravindhan, blessed with lethal charm and a wealthy background of his own, evolved into a ruthless, smooth-talking playboy, while Jegan became his loyal, enabling right-hand man, always ready to fuel Zayn's ego and join in on his reckless lifestyle. Disgusted by Zayn’s toxic behavior, his trail of broken hearts, and Jegan's blind loyalty, Kaushika and Nithin actively chose to walk away from them. By the time they reached college, Kaushika and Nithin had completely distanced themselves from their old schoolmates, establishing a strict, unspoken boundary to keep Zayn’s chaotic energy far away from their new lives—and especially away from the innocent, sheltered Tara.
The fragile peace shatters when Zayn, always looking for a new conquest to cure his boredom, sets his sights on Kaushika. Driven by a mix of nostalgia and his relentless playboy instinct, Zayn begins aggressively pursuing her, completely ignoring the clear boundaries she and Nithin have set. Witnessing her best friend's growing distress and knowing Zayn's destructive track record, Tara's fierce loyalty overrides her naturally timid, nerdy persona. She realizes that standard warnings won't stop a predator like Zayn, so she devises a daring, high-stakes plan: she will throw herself into his orbit to shield Kaushika. Stepping out from the shadows of the library, the wealthy but unassuming nerd deliberately crosses paths with the campus kingpin, boldly proposing a game of her own to catch his attention. Tara's ultimate goal is to make Zayn fall for her instead, intentionally entering a dangerous web of fake dating and psychological chess to distract him, tame his ego, and permanently protect the friends who mean the world to her.
Tara and Zayn is a dangerous game of love where the biggest mistake they can make is falling for each other.

title: Oh Humnava Tum Dena Saath Mera
wikiTitle: Oh Humnava Tum Dena Saath Mera
summary: Oh Humnava - Tum Dena Saath Mera (transl. Oh my soulmate, please stay by my side) is an Indian Hindi-language romantic drama television series that premiered on 20 April 2026 on StarPlus and streams digitally on JioHotstar. Produced by Prateek Sharma under Studio LSD Private Limited, the series stars Sriti Jha and Shabir Ahluwalia. It is an official remake of Star Pravah's Marathi series Man Dhaga Dhaga Jodte Nava.
plot: Having left a tough marriage, Aparajita wanted to start anew, but things got complicated because people judged her for being divorced. Despite her bravery in getting out of a difficult situation, society's opinions made finding happiness a bit of a challenge. The label of being divorced acted as a constant reminder of her past, making it hard for her to move forward without facing judgment.
reception: In its opening week, the show recorded a BARC TRP of 1.1 in week 16 of 2026 and for several weeks, the show hovered with a steady 0.9 TRP. However, the ratings saw a positive jump by Week 22, climbing to a 1.0 rating. It maintained the same low rating of 1.0 in weeks 23 & 24.

title: Comedy Cooks
summary: Comedy Cooks is an Indian Malayalam-language comedy-based cooking competition show. It premiered on 18 April 2026 on Asianet and streaming on JioHotstar. The show is an official adaptation of Tamil TV show Cooku with Comali. The series marks debut of actress Bhavana to the television medium as the show's primary judge. The show ended on 2 August 2026 with Hungry Mahi emerging as winner and Sabumon Abdusamad as runner-up.

articleSections.title: Concept and format
articleSections.text: The show follows a format where celebrity participants, designated as "Cooks," are paired with comedians, referred to as "Pookies." The contestants must prepare various dishes within a set time limit while managing physical and situational obstacles introduced by the comedians. The dishes are then evaluated by a panel of judges.

title: Matka King
summary:
Matka King is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language period crime drama television series created by Nagraj Popatrao Manjule and Abhay Koranne based on the story concept by Ashish Aryan for Amazon Prime Video. It stars Vijay Varma, Sai Tamhankar, Bhupendra Jadawat, Kritika Kamra, Gulshan Grover and Siddharth Jadhav in lead roles. Set in the 1960s Mumbai, the series traces the transformation of a humble, enterprising cotton trader into a powerful gambling don as he starts a new game called Matka, that takes the city by storm and democratizes a terrain previously reserved for the rich and elite.
The series is renewed for a second season by Amazon Prime Video which is in development.
plot:
Matka King is a gripping crime drama set in the 1960s Mumbai. The series builds its world around a modest cotton trader, Brij Bhatti, who, starts an illegal "Matka" betting game, showing how a small, almost harmless gambling idea gradually evolves into a massive underground empire that is controlled by money, politics, and fear.
At its core, the show is less about gambling and more about ambition. It explores how greed reshapes a man's morals as he climbs from poverty to power, and how that power slowly begins to destroy everything around him. Vijay Varma delivers a strong and controlled performance, carrying the emotional weight of a man who is both intelligent and deeply flawed.
reception:
Anuj Kumar for The Hindu wrote "‘Matka King’ turns out to be a familiar but gripping crime drama that is worth betting on."
Shubhra Gupta for The Indian Express rated the series 2/5 stars and stated "the matka-addicted mill-workers and their unions whose movement kept Bombay's greedy sharks at bay, remain a scratchy backdrop."
Rahul Desai for The Hollywood Reporter India wrote "Along the way, there are glimpses of the intellect buried within the algorithm."
Deepansh Duggal for The Quint stated "Instead of unfolding organically, the plot feels like it is delivered in bursts, with too much information packed into too little time." Nandini Ramnath for Scroll.in felt that "The eight-episode show suffers from a bit of bloat and threadbare production values." Sana Farzeen of India Today rated the series 3/5 stars and stated "At eight episodes, it feels indulgent."
Tatsam Mukherjee of The Wire expressed "No man-woman pair in the show can do so without falling in love, which I found too escapist and dated." Hardika Gupta from NDTV rated the series 2 out of 5 stars and stated "The result is a story that moves, but rarely surprises; that speaks, but rarely resonates." A reviewer from Amar Ujala rated the series 2.5/5.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: Matka King began streaming on Amazon Prime Video from 17 April 2026.

episodesList.title: Taqdeer, Tadbeer, Tarkeeb!
episodesList.summary: Brij Bhatti is a cotton exchange worker drowning in debt with a pregnant wife and a directionless brother. With ruthless loan sharks at his door and hope as the only currency, Brij faces a life-changing choice: accept his crushing fate or revolutionise the gambling system, a move with ripple effects unknown to Brij himself.

episodesList.title: Umeed Ka Karkhana
episodesList.summary: Integrity is tested when Matka brings Brij both fortune and a target on his back. With a newborn as his lucky charm, Brij reinvents the game, spreading Matka through Bombay's bustling textile mills. While a journalist begins to investigate the rise of Matka, the enigmatic Gulrukh is drawn to the game's allure. Laljibhai orchestrates a plan to dismantle the rising empire, nearly succeeding.

episodesList.title: Izzat Half, Sangam Full
episodesList.summary: Brij enters Mumbai's elite world through Gulrukh's circles but struggles to find his place among the city's old money. As Matka explodes nationwide, reporter T.P. rallies officials against the "Matka King," while Inspector Eknath begins clandestine surveillance. With Minister Bapat plotting a state-level intervention, greed and ambition begin to corrupt Brij's empire from within.

episodesList.title: Tera Pyaar Triple Paana, Mera Pyaar Kabootar Daana
episodesList.summary: Survival requires innovation as the government launches a rival scheme to dismantle Brij's influence. Forced to think outside the box, Brij expands his reach across India, but success demands a heavy sacrifice. Trust fractures within the inner circle, and an enemy strikes where it hurts most when unbridled greed determines to ruin everything.

episodesList.title: Safed Kapde, Kaale Dil
episodesList.summary: Brij adopts a stark new public persona, turning appearance into strategy. While new alliances form, old foundations reveal deep cracks. The game's toll on his home life forces Brij into taking a heartbreaking decision. As Minister Bapat attempts to corner him, Brij proves he is at his most dangerous when his back is against the wall.

episodesList.title: Lights, Camera, Jodi
episodesList.summary: As media attention reaches a fever pitch, Barkha feels the heavy weight of her husband's notoriety. Amidst grand celebrations, Dagdu suffers a profound personal loss, and Gulrukh seeks independence for her own business. Inspector Eknath begins to question his faith in the system as Matka spills into the homes, careers, and consciences of every citizen in Bombay.

episodesList.title: Do Ikke, Ek Gulaam
episodesList.summary: A wedding celebration leaves Brij's world more fractured than ever. Lacchu pursues dangerous new alliances with outside forces, attempting to pull Brij into a darker game. As the pillars of the Matka world begin to crumble and the inner circle splinters, Brij stands his ground even as the true cost of ambition surfaces in unexpected, violent ways.

episodesList.title: Open Aur Close
episodesList.summary: As mill workers go on an indefinite strike, Brij is faced with a decision that will affect the city and the country. Lacchu joins Darab's war for power, while Dagdu's fight for Sulabha fractures the circle. Barkha reclaims her identity, and TP weighs the effect of Matka's involvement in the whole system. As everything that was built stands unprotected, the Matka King must play one last hand.

title: Kaakee Circus
summary: Kaakee Circus is an Indian Tamil-language fantasy comedy-thriller web series written and directed by Ameen Barif. The series stars Munishkanth, Subash Selvam, and Rajesh Madhavan in lead roles. The seven-episode series is set to premier on 10 April 2026.
plot: Set in a sub-jail in a fictional coastal town, the story follows a book-loving jailer and an enthusiastic young constable. Their routine is disrupted when a mysterious and eccentric thief attempts an impossible feat: breaking into the high-security jail. The thief's objective is to steal a temple donation box stored within the premises, leading to a chaotic series of events involving the local police force and the town's residents.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The series was written and directed by Ameen Barif. During its early development stages, the project was titled Once Upon a Time in Kayamkulam before being officially renamed to Kaakee Circus.

episodesList.title: The Walls
episodesList.summary: In a faraway sub-jail, Constable Arjun struggles to manage thieves and learn the ways of the jail from Jailer Anbuselvan. Outside the jail, a mysterious break-in leads to chaos in the silent town.

episodesList.title: The Shadow of the Tree
episodesList.summary: Hari, a man in the village, witnesses disturbing signs and coincidences that trouble his family. Meanwhile, more unusual thefts rattle the town, making everyone suspect each other.

episodesList.title: Two Petty Thieves
episodesList.summary: Varghese, a coffin maker dealing with a troubled past and a failed marriage, becomes embroiled in the town's turmoil. Meanwhile, Arjun and Anbuselvan investigate the mystery of the undiyal money.

episodesList.title: The Passenger's Deception
episodesList.summary: Arjun’s suspicions shift with each individual he encounters. The missing funds from the jail, online rumours, and new clues assist in piecing together the puzzle, yet the mystery remains unresolved.

episodesList.title: Manoj's Yesterday
episodesList.summary: A closer look into the lives of the town’s residents reveals struggles that could have pushed them to steal. Arjun’s job becomes harder, as he can’t draw a line between the victim and the culprit.

episodesList.title: The Rising Heat
episodesList.summary: Arjun grows restless as the investigation leads to dead-ends and every clue comes with a twist. Anbuselvan urges him to be patient, but Arjun is confident the culprit is hiding in plain sight.

episodesList.title: The Escaping Shadow
episodesList.summary: Arjun gets closer to a breakthrough, but a series of incidents leave the case shattered. Anbuselvan questions his ideals, while Arjun doubts his abilities. Can the two find the culprit in time?

title: Hui Gumm Yaadein Ek Doctor, Do Zindagiyaan
wikiTitle: Hui Gumm Yaadein Ek Doctor, Do Zindagiyaan
summary: Hui Gumm Yaadein Ek Doctor, Do Zindagiyaan (also known as Yaadein) is an Indian Hindi-language medical drama television series that premiered on Sony SAB on 6 April 2026 and also streams on SonyLIV. It is an official adaptation of the Italian series Doc – Nelle tue mani. It stars Iqbal Khan, Gulki Joshi, Srishti Singh, Avinn Tyagi.
plot: Dr. Dev Mehta is a skilled, strict and straightforward doctor often called as Mr. Khadoos by his staff. However, he has special place for his junior, Dr. Vaani. Dr. Mehta is divorced from his wife Dr. Srishty Agarwal and distant from his family. He fatally gets shot in the head by the father of one of his patients due to latter's inadvertent death. It turns out Sunny was responsible for the death of the patient whose father shot Dr. Dev but before the incident he found out the truth about Sunny and threatened him about reporting it to the board and terminating his medical license. However, he suffers from amnesia and loses memory of last 8 years of his life. He seems to be changed after the incident despite not remembering anything. Dev learns about his divorce from her wife and about his son's death. Though, he loses all the memory of Dr. Vaani. He tries to win over his colleagues, parents and daughter again with his pleasant nature. Dr. Sunny, husband of Dev's sister, avenge him for earlier trying to terminate his medical license, by humiliating him and ousting him from the hospital. But Dev is able to secure the position of assistant/ward boy in the hospital. He is very kind and understanding towards the patients unlike earlier Dr. Dev Mehta much to the shock of his subordinates.

title: Maa Ka Sum
summary: Maa Ka Sum is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language drama television series written by Ravinder Randhawa and Sumrit Shahi, directed by Nicholas Kharkongor. Produced under Eunoia Films, the series stars Mona Singh, Mihir Ahuja and Angira Dhar.
reception:
Sukanya Verma of Rediff rated the series two star out of five stars, writing, "Despite a promising premise, the eight-part series is overly enamoured with the protagonist's 'geekdom' and failing to deliver a believable mother-son slice-of-life story." Shubhra Gupta from The Indian Express gave the series out of 5 stars. Riya Sharma of Hindustan Times awarded the series 3/5 stars.
Rahul Desai of The Hollywood Reporter India commeneted that "The numbers just don’t add up." Udita Jhunjhunwala writing for the Scroll.in observed that "Maa Ka Sum begins as a cutesy, almost saccharine dramedy before veering into darker territory touching on issues such as mental health and abandonment. These shifts feel abrupt and underdeveloped, as though the series is trying to mount seriousness on an already shaky foundation."
Kartik Bhardwaj of Cinema Express rated it 2/5 stars and said that "The Prime Video show is a mere assemblage of elements lacking the x factor". Sana Farzeen of India Today also gave 2 stars out of 5 and said that "What begins as a clever, promising concept slowly turns into an overextended equation, one that keeps working itself out without arriving at a meaningful answer. And in the process, it does something unexpected. It makes math feel exhausting all over again."

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The series was announced on Amazon Prime Video. A special screening of the series was held at Mumbai on 4 April 2026.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The trailer of the series was released on 27 March 2026. The series was made available to stream on Amazon Prime Video on 3 April 2026.

Rahul Desai of The Hollywood Reporter India commeneted that "The numbers just don’t add up." Udita Jhunjhunwala writing for the Scroll.in observed that "Maa Ka Sum begins as a cutesy, almost saccharine dramedy before veering into darker territory touching on issues such as mental health and abandonment. These shifts feel abrupt and underdeveloped, as though the series is trying to mount seriousness on an already shaky foundation."
Kartik Bhardwaj of Cinema Express rated it 2/5 stars and said that "The Prime Video show is a mere assemblage of elements lacking the x factor". Sana Farzeen of India Today also gave 2 stars out of 5 and said that "What begins as a clever, promising concept slowly turns into an overextended equation, one that keeps working itself out without arriving at a meaningful answer. And in the process, it does something unexpected. It makes math feel exhausting all over again."

episodesList.title: The Blueprint
episodesList.summary: Agastya, a math prodigy, prevents a fellow student from jumping off a building using maths. He shares a bittersweet dinner with his mother, Vinita, marking his father's abandonment. As Vinita explores dating, Agastya navigates his own breakup. A bookstore encounter with a woman, where his math skills fail him, leaves him baffled. The next day, a new math professor inspires an idea to help Vinita.

episodesList.title: Work-In-Progress
episodesList.summary: Agastya hacks a dating app for Vinita, but his algorithm picks terrible dates. To get into his professor's class, he must find her a home, but his data-driven approach fails. His professor teaches him to temper genius with real-world observation, inspiring him to create a new and improved dating algorithm. Meanwhile, Annie hides a secret.

episodesList.title: Progress
episodesList.summary: Agastya refines Vinita's dating profile with verified data, finally leading to successful dates for her. Ira allows him to attend her class. Vinita's real estate deal collapses due to Abhimanyu. Annie ends up in hospital due to the pills, leading to a fight with Agastya. Agastya shares his algorithm with Ira. Vinita encounters Abhimanyu again, who apologizes to her.

episodesList.title: Off Track
episodesList.summary: Vinita and Abhimanyu connect, but Agastya forbids her to date him, fearing it will disrupt his algorithm. At Ira's party, Agastya meets Heartset's founder and discovers that Ira worked on that algorithm. Ira suggests that she and Agastya create a new algorithm. Annie confesses her feelings for Agastya. Agastya discovers that Vinita is still seeing Abhimanyu.

episodesList.title: The Tipping Point
episodesList.summary: Agastya confronts Vinita. As he remembers his father's abandonment, he suffers a panic attack at college and is helped by Annie. Ira challenges his bias against Abhimanyu. Agastya asks Spidey to hack Abhimanyu's social media. At a concert, Agastya and Ira both feel unwell from a spiked drink.

episodesList.title: The Unravelling
episodesList.summary: Agastya schemes to end Vinita's relationship. Ira suspects Agastya spiked her drink. Annie reveals her past trauma to Agastya, resolving their past and inspiring a memorial for her brother. Vinita receives incriminating photos of Abhimanyu. Agastya is late for the memorial, causing a rift with his friends. Agastya and Ira share a tender moment. Agastya faces a stark realization.

episodesList.title: The Final Piece
episodesList.summary: Agastya confesses his feelings to Ira. Abhimanyu reveals some jolting news about Agastya, shocking Vinita. Agastya has a meltdown when confronted. As his graffiti wall is destroyed, he has a breakthrough in his algorithm. Ira is pushed to make a tough decision. Overwhelmed with everything, Agastya gets into trouble.

When Agastya goes missing and lands in jail after a fight, his friends bail him out. As he navigates his mother's hurt because of his actions and receives an enlightening letter from Ira, he is forced to confront the limits of logic and maths in matters of the heart and human connection. He learns that some things-like love-can't be calculated.

summary: Muthu Engira Kaattaan (transl. Muthu alias Kaattaan) is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language television series written and directed by M. Manikandan, B. Ajithkumar and La. Rajkumar for JioHotstar. The primary cast includes Vijay Sethupathi, Milind Soman and others. The show produced by Vijay Sethupathi under the banner of Vijay Sethupathi Productions. It premiered in JioHotstar on 27 March 2026.
reception:

It's an imperfect season, but one that leaves you wanting a second. Vishal Menon writing for The Hollywood Reporter India noted that "A mysterious character study loses its way and The mood is that of a dark comedy and the characters layered, but the series loses its way and transforms into an elaborate backstory.
Nandini Ramnath of Scroll.in writes in her review that "The 10 episodes are devoted as much to detailing as to detection. The series is decisively not in a neo-noir mould, with rustic settings, rooted characters and a refreshing absence of cynicism." Bhuvanesh Chandar of The Hindu observed that "Manikandan makes an impressive series debut with ‘Kaattaan,’ which takes viewers on a thrilling, slow-burn journey through the fragmented life of an one-of-a-kind, mysterious dead man."

title: Chiraiya
summary:
Chiraiya (transl. "Bird") is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language drama web series directed by Shashant Shah and produced by SVF Entertainment. It stars Divya Dutta, Sanjay Mishra, Siddharth Shaw and Prasanna Bisht. It is an adaptation of the Bengali web series Sampurna.
The series began streaming on JioHotstar from 20 March 2026 and has become one of the most popular Hindi series on the platform in recent months.
plot: A young bride navigates a suffocating marriage, battling for autonomy in a society that values family honour over her consent. The show confronts marital rape, exposing the myth of implied consent within marriage and highlighting her emotional and psychological struggle for dignity.

articleSections.title: Critical reception
articleSections.text:
Archika Khurana of The Times of India gave 3.5 stars and wrote "At its core, the series tackles the sensitive and rarely explored subject of marital rape, challenging the deeply ingrained belief that marriage implies automatic consent. But rather than turning into a loud, didactic social commentary, Chiraiya chooses a more introspective route. It does not point fingers; it holds up a mirror."
Shreyas Pande of The Hindu reviewed the series and highlighted "Through its accessible storytelling, the show offers a sharp portrayal of patriarchy and its impact on families, even though the presentation lacks finesse, making it clunky in some portions."
Rahul Desai of The Hollywood Reporter India writes that "Not the gender empowerment story we deserve" and describe it as "A liberal mind undone by a conservative body".
Vinamra Mathur of Firstpost rated it 3.5 stars and said that "In most of the Hindi movies that we have seen, the wedding room represents intimacy, to celebrate what we call Suhaagrat. In Chiraiya, it’s depicted as a room for horror and loneliness. And it has been done well."
Udita Jhunjhunwala writing for Scroll.in observed that "Chiraiya is saying something that matters, but it leans so heavily on its message that it begins to feel less like a story and more like a lesson."
Sana Farzeen of India Today gave 3.5 stars and writes that "It does not claim to have all the answers. Instead, it leaves you with questions – difficult, uncomfortable, necessary questions. Because sometimes, the first step towards change is not action, but acknowledgement. And in a society that still struggles to even name the problem, that in itself is a powerful beginning."
BH Harsh of Cinema Express rated it 3.5 stars and said that "Chiraiya tells us to be cautious of those animals who thrive in broad society under the endearing allure of poetry."
Arpita Sarkar of OTT Play gave 3 stars out of 5 and said that "Chiraiya is a socially important series that highlights issues such as marital abuse, consent, and patriarchal norms."

title: Kyunki Rishton Ke Bhi Roop Badalte Hain
wikiTitle: Kyunki Rishton Ke Bhi Roop Badalte Hain
summary: Kyunki Rishton Ke Bhi Roop Badalte Hain (transl. Because The Forms of Relationships Change Too) is an Indian Hindi-language romantic drama television series that premiered on Star Plus on 20 March 2026 and streams digitally on JioHotstar. Produced by Ekta Kapoor under Balaji Telefilms, it is a spin-off of Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi 2 and stars Tanisha Mehta and Rohit Suchanti in lead roles.
plot: Angad and Vrinda Virani start off on a secret mission in Jamshedpur after they send their kids to boarding school.
reception: Kyunki Rishton Ke Bhi Roop Badalte Hain was in the second position of BARC rating list in its launch week with a TRP of 1.9 and had a reach of 2.3 million impressions and in the third position in its second week of week 12. The show fell to sixth position in week 13. In week 14, the show ranked at fifth place and recorded a 1.7 TRP and 2.3 TVR. In May, it maintained a rating of 1.4 and continued to be in top 10 shows. The series saw a decline in ratings and got a 1.2 TVR at ninth place in week 21 of June 2026.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
Following a positive response to the reboot version, a separate storyline featuring Angad and Vrinda, initially as an extension of Kyunki Saas... , was launched which was telecasted in the later part of the episodes.
It was rumoured that the show would eventually replace the parent series. However, the channel debunked these rumours by issuing an official statement clarifying that the claims were false and that Kyunki Saas... was not ending anytime soon.
Amid rumours surrounding a proposed spin-off of Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi, along with the circulation of unauthorised promotional content suggesting her involvement, Smriti Irani issued a legal warning against the misuse of her name and image. Irani clarified that she is not involved in any such project.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Rohit Suchanti and Tanisha Mehta initially entered the spin-off as Angad and Vrinda under secret identities while investigating issues at the Jamshedpur plant. Kushagre Dua was signed to play the negative lead, Vikrant Thakur, while Pradeep Singh Toor joined the cast in a pivotal role as a factory worker. In April 2026, Tanish Mahendru re-entered the series as Ranvijay. Later, Aman Gandhi, Prachi Singh, Shriya Tiwari, and Navein Prakash joined the spin-off, reprising their respective roles from the original series. In June 2026, Shakti Anand and Prachi Kowli, portraying Advocate Hemant and Pooja Virani respectively, also shifted to the show.
In July 2026, the show took a leap of 10 years along with the parent show. Gaurav S Bajaj joined the show to portray Mr. Kartik Patel, a businessman opposite Tanisha Mehta. Het Thakkar was cast as grown-up Akshay Virani. Barkha Bisht returned to the spin-off as Noina.
In August 2026, Aman Gandhi who played Hritik Virani, left the show as well as the parent show Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi 2 for his new project. Actor Shubh Karaan Bhopal was then cast to replace Gandhi as Hritik.

episodesList.title: Angad Under Bharati's Scrutiny
episodesList.summary: Vrinda appreciates Angad's smart handling of the situation. Bharati digs deeper into his hidden link, her growing obsession revealing a disturbing intensity.

episodesList.title: Bharati's Confession to Angad
episodesList.summary: Bharati admits her love for Angad, making Mangal furious. Later, Angad tries to talk to Vrinda about Bharati, but finds her busy with work.

episodesList.title: Angad's Compelled Choice
episodesList.summary: To save his job, Angad agrees to marry Bharati at Biku Dada's insistence. Bharati celebrates while Angad feels torn as he thinks about Vrinda.

episodesList.title: Bharati Faces Angad's Truth
episodesList.summary: Angad has a frightening dream of Vrinda's outburst upon learning that Bharati loves him. He then tries to explain to Bharati that he can't reciprocate her feelings.

episodesList.title: Angad Fears for Bharati
episodesList.summary: Angad stresses about Bharati's false hopes of marrying him. Soon after, Vrinda grows anxious about Angad's whereabouts and goes to meet him.

episodesList.title: Mangal Strikes a Deal
episodesList.summary: Vrinda urges Angad to obtain workers' signatures on a memorandum of understanding. Mangal demands an advance bonus in exchange for signing the agreement.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Doubts Angad's Intentions
episodesList.summary: Angad chooses duty over power, but a small moment creates big doubts in Vrinda's heart. As she distances herself, Vikrant steps in and changes everything.

episodesList.title: Bharati's Shocking Offer to Mangal
episodesList.summary: Angad grows insecure when Vikrant holds Vrinda's hand, and he alerts her. Then, Bharati pressures Mangal to sign the memorandum, promising to marry him in return.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Gets Jealous
episodesList.summary: Bharati's gesture sparks a misunderstanding, leaving Vrinda heartbroken, and she shuts Angad out. When Angad secretly sneaks in, Vikrant's claim about a thief adds tension.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Probes Workers
episodesList.summary: Vrinda and Angad feel insecure and confront each other over their concerns. Vikrant investigates the workers to identify who sneaked into Vrinda's house the previous day.

episodesList.title: Bharati Saves Angad
episodesList.summary: Angad is caught injured, but Bharati saves him with a quick cover-up. Mangal talks to Biku Dada about his wedding with Bharati, while she denies it.

episodesList.title: Vrinda's Heart Breaks in Silence
episodesList.summary: As Biku Dada announces Angad and Bharati's roka, Vrinda is left heartbroken watching it unfold. But Angad's bold refusal sparks hope, as he promises to set things right.

episodesList.title: Trouble Deepens for Angad
episodesList.summary: A wrong call to Malti lands Angad in deeper chaos as he seeks her help to fix things. Vrinda faces a shocking situation at the empty factory and is disheartened.

episodesList.title: Vrinda's Heartbreak at Angad's Roka
episodesList.summary: Vrinda walks into Angad's Roka and agrees to stay as family, hiding her pain. But as the ceremony unfolds, seeing Angad with Bharati together breaks her completely.

episodesList.title: Angad and Bharati's Roka Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Vrinda is left shattered when she's asked to perform the Roka rituals for Angad and Bharati. Malti questions Angad about the sudden alliance, and he seeks her support.

episodesList.title: Angad's Heartfelt Apology to Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Realising it was his and Vrinda's anniversary, Angad buys a cake and goes to her place. He apologises, but Vrinda remains upset over his Roka ceremony with Bharati.

episodesList.title: Bharati Stands Up for Angad
episodesList.summary: Angad tells Vrinda about import and export activities at the factory. Bharati defends Angad when Vikrant accuses him of hurting the watchman.

episodesList.title: Ranvijay's Shocking Entry
episodesList.summary: Angad shares last night's truth with Biku Dada as his engagement with Bharati is finalised. Tension rises when Vrinda and Angad see Ranvijay at the factory.

episodesList.title: Vrinda, Angad Uncover the Plot
episodesList.summary: Biku Dada rushes preparations for Angad's and Bharati's engagement. Meanwhile, Vrinda and Angad uncover Mangal's link to Ranvijay, raising suspicions.

episodesList.title: Bharati Plays a Smart Move
episodesList.summary: Angad tries to convince Bharati to cancel the engagement, but things don't go as planned. Bharati secretly takes matters into her hands by sharing Malti's number with Biku Dada.

episodesList.title: Bharati Stunned by Vrinda's Actions
episodesList.summary: Angad calls Mangal from another phone, urging him to stop his wedding to Bharati. He tries to cover up when questioned by Bharati, who is shocked to see Vrinda caring for Angad.

episodesList.title: Vrinda's Plan Unfolds
episodesList.summary: Bharati invites Vrinda to her engagement with Angad. Angad confirms his intent to marry Bharati. Meanwhile, Vrinda plots to ruin the engagement by exiting Jamshedpur.

episodesList.title: Angad and Bharati Get Engaged
episodesList.summary: Angad secretly slips out of his engagement to meet Vrinda, unaware that she has met with a tragic accident. He returns and gets engaged with Bharati while Malti arrives.

episodesList.title: Biku Dada Is Stunned by Angad's Truth
episodesList.summary: Malti plants fear in Biku Dada's mind, claiming that Angad is Manglik, risking Bharati's life. Vrinda arrives injured and is devastated to learn about the engagement.

episodesList.title: Hrithik Guides Angad
episodesList.summary: The priest advises Angad to marry a tree first to cleanse his sins. Hrithik informs Angad that Ranvijay is involved in factory scams with the help of the management.

episodesList.title: Angad Reassures Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Angad asks Vrinda to trust him one last time so he can expose the factory scam. Angad secretly regrets hurting Vrinda by marrying Bharati.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Tracks the Factory Scam
episodesList.summary: After the watchman alerts Vrinda, she uncovers leads about the factory scam. Malti plans to break Angad and Bharati's wedding by demanding dowry from Biku Dada.

episodesList.title: Malti's Plan Crumbles
episodesList.summary: Malti's plan backfires as Biku Dada decides to sell his property to fund Bharati's dowry. Vrinda confides in Angad about following the consignment to reach the scammer.

episodesList.title: Angad, Vrinda Record Mangal's Con
episodesList.summary: Vrinda and Angad follow Mangal as he deals with stolen factory goods and record the scam. Vrinda confronts Mangal about the scam, but he stands fearless against her.

episodesList.title: Ranvijay Trapped by Angad-Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Ranvijay confronts Vrinda and threatens her to delete his video. Angad steps in to protect her and Ranvijay is stunned when Angad presents solid proof exposing his crimes.

episodesList.title: Angad's Ultimatum to Ranvijay
episodesList.summary: Angad demands that Ranvijay transfer all his shares to Virani Industries. Meanwhile, Hrithik passionately insists that Vrinda keep her shares, declaring them her rightful due.

episodesList.title: Mangal Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: While the police arrive to arrest Mangal, Biku Dada fumes at Mangal for creating a scam. Angad and Vrinda decide to reveal the truth about their relationship to Biku Dada.

episodesList.title: Biku Dada's Critical Condition
episodesList.summary: Bharati is devastated as Biku Dada suffers a heart attack and needs urgent surgery. She struggles to stay strong while Vrinda and Angad are shocked to find an unexpected note.

episodesList.title: Biku Dada's Sudden Demise
episodesList.summary: As Biku Dada's condition turns critical, Bharati reveals his last wish to see her married to Angad. Angad fulfils the ritual in the hospital, and Biku Dada passes away.

episodesList.title: Angad Performs the Final Rites
episodesList.summary: Vrinda is shocked to see Bharati with sindoor and tells Malti about it. Angad performs Biku Dada's final rituals, leaving Bharati emotionally broken.

episodesList.title: Angad Loses Vrinda's Trust
episodesList.summary: Vikrant warns employees that Angad is becoming the workers' union leader. Meanwhile, Angad tries to convince Vrinda that he did not apply vermilion to Bharati's hair.

episodesList.title: Angad Struggles to Reveal the Truth
episodesList.summary: Determined to end the confusion, Angad decides to finally confess the truth to Bharati, with Malti supporting him. Meanwhile, the workers decide to make Angad their union leader.

episodesList.title: Angad Fights for Justice
episodesList.summary: All the factory workers protest for injured Lalan. Angad demands Vrinda compensate him and boldly accuses Vikrant of mismanagement as tensions erupt at the factory gates.

episodesList.title: Angad Leads a Hunger Strike
episodesList.summary: Angad demands compensation for Lallan, but Vrinda's harsh behaviour sparks tension between them. As Vikrant fuels the conflict, Angad takes a bold step by leading a hunger strike.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Caught in Emotional Turmoil
episodesList.summary: Vrinda worries about Angad and the differences between them as he sits on a hunger strike. Malti urges Angad to resolve his issues with Vrinda and reveal the truth to Bharati.

episodesList.title: Bharati Saves Angad from Jail
episodesList.summary: The workers continue their strike as the police arrive to arrest Angad, leaving tensions at the factory. Bharati arranges Angad's bail, and after his release, he confronts Vrinda.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Suspects Vrinda's Truth
episodesList.summary: Stunned by learning about Vrinda's pregnancy, Vikrant decides to uncover the truth. Elsewhere, Vrinda urges Angad to confess everything to Bharati before complications arise.

episodesList.title: Angad, Vrinda Under Secret Trail
episodesList.summary: As Vikrant questions Vrinda about the school invitation, she grows anxious. To uncover the truth, Vikrant and Bharati secretly follow Vrinda and Angad to the school.

episodesList.title: The Clever Catch: Angad and Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Vikrant learns that Vrinda is married, and Bharati is shocked that Angad already has a wife. Vrinda and Angad sense that Vikrant and Bharati are suspicious of them.

episodesList.title: Bharati Confronts Angad
episodesList.summary: Angad apologises to Vrinda for his past mistakes and plans to reveal the truth at the factory. Bharati fiercely questions Angad about his wife, already knowing the truth.

episodesList.title: Bharati Learns Angad's Truth
episodesList.summary: Vrinda confronts Vikrant for secretly following her, while Angad reveals the truth about his marriage to Vrinda. In a moment of rage, Bharati attacks Angad with a knife.

episodesList.title: Angad's True Identity Unfolds
episodesList.summary: Vrinda apologises to Bharati for hiding the truth and hurting her feelings. A shocker hits Vikrant and the workers when Vrinda reveals Angad's real identity.

episodesList.title: Bharati Is Overwhelmed with Emotion
episodesList.summary: As Nandu declines the union leader role, Vrinda and Angad suggest that Bharati take it up. Devastated, Bharati misses Biku Dada and recalls their past moments together.

episodesList.title: Angad Exposes the Real Culprit
episodesList.summary: Vrinda backs Bharati as the new union leader but falls ill, and Vikrant rushes her to the doctor. Meanwhile, Angad investigates the missing bank papers and uncovers the culprit.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Walks Free by Blame Game
episodesList.summary: Vikrant frames Suresh for fraud and pretends to be emotional in front of Vrinda and Angad. Angad loses his temper and fires the women spreading gossip about Vrinda and Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Angad Fires Vikrant
episodesList.summary: A sweet moment between Angad and Vrinda turns tense as she feels dizzy. Vikrant records before Angad gets furious at him and dismisses him from his job.

episodesList.title: Vrinda, Angad's Heated Argument
episodesList.summary: Tensions rise as Angad and Vrinda clash over Vikrant's removal from the job. After a while, gossip about Vrinda's pregnancy leaves Angad disturbed.

episodesList.title: Vrinda's Move Angers Angad!
episodesList.summary: DGP Sangram storms into the factory to arrest Angad for firing Vikrant unfairly. Angad gets furious after Vrinda takes Vikrant back on the job.

episodesList.title: Bharati Guides Angad
episodesList.summary: Vrinda resigns from the company, while Bharati advises Angad to support her. Everyone at the factory eagerly awaits who Angad will choose to replace Vrinda's position.

episodesList.title: Vrinda's Surprise Plan for Angad
episodesList.summary: Vrinda agrees to Vikrant's idea of planning Angad's birthday surprise, unaware of his motives. Mangal reveals Vikrant's role in the factory loss, raising Angad's doubts.

episodesList.title: Angad's Special Birthday Bash
episodesList.summary: Vrinda surprises Angad with a birthday celebration, making him happy. During the dance, Kripa intentionally pushes Vrinda onto Vikrant, causing chaos at the party.

episodesList.title: Angad Hides the Truth from Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Angad convinces Vrinda to repeat her tests as he struggles with the burden of hiding the truth about the paternity test from her. He gets the test done and breaks down emotionally.

episodesList.title: Angad Faces an Emotional Storm
episodesList.summary: Angad struggles to process the shocking paternity test results. Mangal and Vikrant are pleased as their plan succeeds, and Vikrant reveals how he altered the reports.

episodesList.title: Angad's Hidden Test Shocks Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Angad shares the test report with Bharati, while a voice note of Vikrant's and Vrinda's conversation fumes him. Shocked to learn about the paternity test, Vrinda confronts Angad.

episodesList.title: Trust Breaks Between Angad, Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Angad confronts Vrinda with evidence against her, but she insists it is false and pleads her case. Overwhelmed by doubt, Angad breaks down before Bharati.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Seeks Vikrant's Help
episodesList.summary: Vrinda confides in Vikrant about the fake voice recording and seeks his support. However, Angad learns the truth from Vikrant, deepening his pain and triggering a confrontation.

episodesList.title: Angad's Demand Sparks a Clash
episodesList.summary: Angad demands that Vrinda abort her pregnancy, sparking a bitter clash. As guilt and memories haunt him, Angad confronts Mangal over the voice recording.

episodesList.title: Angad and Vrinda Seek Separation
episodesList.summary: A misunderstanding surrounding a lawyer's visit pushes Angad and Vrinda closer to divorce. Their lives take an unexpected turn when Hrithik and Munni suddenly arrive.

episodesList.title: Vrinda, Angad's Secret Exposed
episodesList.summary: Angad and Vrinda perform the pooja at the factory, but their strained behaviour raises suspicions. Angad walks away in the middle of the pooja and reveals the truth to everyone.

episodesList.title: Hrithik Rebukes Angad
episodesList.summary: Hrithik condemns Angad for making allegations against Vrinda. Meanwhile, Vrinda confides in Munni and Saloni about her pain and her decision to separate from Angad.

episodesList.title: Will Angad, Vrinda Reconcile?
episodesList.summary: Angad and Vrinda get into a heated argument about their chaotic relationship. Munni and Hrithik discuss how to stop Vrinda and Angad's fight and bring them closer together.

episodesList.title: Munni's Lie Hurts Vrinda
episodesList.summary: After learning about Munni's lie, an upset Vrinda confronts her. Later, Munni and Hrithik urge Vrinda and Angad to attend the awards for the company's reputation.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Wins a Prestigious Award
episodesList.summary: Vrinda receives the Business Entrepreneur Award and credits Angad for her success. However, Angad shocks everyone by refusing to pose for a media photo.

episodesList.title: Hrithik's Advice to Angad
episodesList.summary: Hrithik counsels Angad to give Vrinda a second chance and rebuild their bond. Elsewhere, Vikrant begins his plan to create rifts between Vrinda and Angad.

episodesList.title: Dev Fumes at Shaloni
episodesList.summary: Dev vents his frustration about their relationship to Shaloni. Angad and Vrinda reassure a frightened Akshay that Dev and Shaloni will not get divorced.

episodesList.title: Angad, Vrinda's Divorce Crisis
episodesList.summary: A nostalgic moment brings joy to Vrinda and Angad, but reality soon hits. Soon, divorce papers arrive, leaving Akshay and Madhavi devastated.

episodesList.title: Vikrant's Sinister Plan
episodesList.summary: Vrinda and Angad worry as Akshay and Madhavi go missing. Seizing the opportunity, Vikrant decides to use Akshay and Madhavi to deepen the rift between Vrinda and Angad.

episodesList.title: Angad, Vrinda Reconcile
episodesList.summary: Bharati recounts how she found Akshay and Madhavi. Angad and Vrinda decide to stay together for Akshay and Madhavi and promise Akshay they will not divorce.

episodesList.title: Hemant Chooses Vrinda to Lead
episodesList.summary: Hrithik announces the client's confirmation of the order, sparking celebrations. Soon, Hemant's arrival delights the family as he entrusts the project responsibility to Vrinda.

episodesList.title: Vrinda, Angad Trapped in a Room
episodesList.summary: As Vrinda goes to the storeroom for files, Vikrant has Kripa lock it. Then, Angad saves Vrinda from falling, only to find they are stuck inside the room together.

episodesList.title: Vikrant's Plan for Angad Backfires
episodesList.summary: Vikrant's attempt to create doubts in Angad about Vrinda fails when he finds them together. Meanwhile, Munni confronts Kripa for locking the storeroom.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Bags a Business Deal
episodesList.summary: Tensions rise when Angad criticises Vrinda's designs as middle-class during a meeting. Determined to prove herself, she impresses the client and locks the deal.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Dazzles Amid Chaos
episodesList.summary: Trouble brews for Vrinda at the launch event when the models fail to show up. Amid the crisis, Vrinda dazzles in a showstopper bridal outfit, but Vikrant's move creates chaos.

episodesList.title: Pooja Surprises the Viranis
episodesList.summary: Pooja pays a surprise visit to the Viranis, while a drunk Angad clashes with Vrinda over Vikrant. Dev taking money from the office without making an entry leads to conflicts.

episodesList.title: Hemant Slams Angad
episodesList.summary: Hemant confronts Angad for doubting Vrinda. Hrithik urges Munni to prioritise her health, while Pooja stops Hemant from revealing Angad and Vrinda's issues to Tulsi.

episodesList.title: Vrinda, Munni and Saloni's Bond
episodesList.summary: Munni, Vrinda, and Saloni embrace, reaffirming their friendship with a promise of support. Five months later, Angad consults a lawyer about divorcing Vrinda.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Arrives for Her Baby Shower
episodesList.summary: As the family prepares for Vrinda's baby shower, Angad returns home drunk. While Nitin and Supriya celebrate the baby's arrival, Munni lovingly prepares Timsi for the newborn.

episodesList.title: Tension Rises at the Baby Shower
episodesList.summary: The family celebrates the baby shower of Vrinda, Munni, and Saloni with joyful rituals. While everyone enjoys the celebrations, Vikrant arrives and Angad grows aggressive.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Hides Dev's Truth
episodesList.summary: Angad tells his lawyer that he wants to cancel his divorce from Vrinda. Dev fears his factory theft will be exposed, but Vikrant hides the truth from the family.

episodesList.title: Angad Sees The Truth?
episodesList.summary: Vrinda questions Vikrant about Kripa's pregnancy, but Dev secretly records their conversation. He later uses the video to drive a wedge between Angad and Vrinda.

episodesList.title: Angad, Vrinda's Rift Deepens
episodesList.summary: Influenced by Parth's words, Dev stirs Angad's distress. Vrinda's joy fades as Angad confronts her, showing a video of her and Vikrant, and Kripa's move leaves her stunned.

episodesList.title: Virani Bahus in Trouble!
episodesList.summary: An emergency forces Hemant and Pooja to leave for Mumbai. The Virani Bahus struggle through labour pains, with no one present to come to their aid.

episodesList.title: Vrinda's Destiny Takes a Dark Turn
episodesList.summary: Hrithik is overwhelmed as he meets Munni and their baby, while Dev and Saloni cherish their newborn. The family's joy ends as the doctor reveals Vrinda's baby couldn't be saved.

episodesList.title: The Virani Bahus Hide a Big Secret
episodesList.summary: The Virani bahus secretly exchange their newborns and vow to keep the truth hidden. As the family celebrates the babies' arrival, Vrinda accuses Angad of pushing her.

episodesList.title: Vrinda's Shocking Decision
episodesList.summary: After signing the divorce papers with Angad, Vrinda resigns from the factory. However, before leaving the house, she confronts Kripa over her betrayal.

episodesList.title: Angad Confronts Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Angad hits Vikrant for driving a wedge between him and Vrinda. Later, Vrinda receives Angad's letter stating he is leaving and has transferred all his property to her name.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Shapes Aarav's Values
episodesList.summary: Hemant requests Vrinda to stay back for the sake of the children, while Angad regrets his actions. Ten years later, Vrinda nurtures Aarav with family values and bonds with him.

episodesList.title: Madhavi's Digital Dream
episodesList.summary: As Madhavi aspires to pursue a career in content creation, Akshay and Vrinda insist that she prioritise her studies. Then, Hemant introduces the Virani family members to Karthik.

episodesList.title: Karthik's Shocking Revelation
episodesList.summary: Priyanka grows anxious about her wedding alliance with Karthik, and the family try to calm her. The family are shocked when Karthik reveals he likes Vrinda, not Priyanka.

episodesList.title: Timsi, Madhavi on a Mission
episodesList.summary: Hemant tries to convince Vrinda to marry Karthik, while Timsi and Madhavi secretly call Karthik to learn more about him. Dev tells Saloni that Karthik would benefit his business.

episodesList.title: Karthik's Business Deal with Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Hemant tells Vrinda that Karthik is coming to the office for a client meeting. Impressed by Vrinda's presentation, Karthik looks forward to doing business with her.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Refuses Karthik's Invitation
episodesList.summary: Karthik invites Vrinda to the AV singing concert, but she refuses. Vrinda later tells Hemant that Karthik offered them the tickets to help coordinate their business deal.

episodesList.title: Karthik Cares for Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Hrithik insists that Vrinda keep her professional and personal life separate. Karthik urges the management to provide excellent care and hospitality for Vrinda and her family.

episodesList.title: A Shocker for the Viranis
episodesList.summary: The Viranis arrive at AV's concert, unaware that the performer is Angad. They are later stunned when Karthik introduces Noina as his business associate.

episodesList.title: Angad's Presence Felt by Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Vrinda senses Angad's presence when AV offers her tissues, awakening old emotions. Hemant tells Dev they'll cut ties with Karthik's firm if Noina is involved in business.

episodesList.title: Akshay Spots Angad?
episodesList.summary: As Vrinda feels pain in AV's voice, Akshay catches a glimpse of a man and suspects he is Angad. Moments later, a fight breaks out, leaving Akshay injured.

episodesList.title: Hemant's Ultimatum to Karthik
episodesList.summary: Angad disguises himself as a doctor to escape the hospital. Hemant tells Karthik he can't do business with him if Noina is involved, deepening the rift.

episodesList.title: Hemant's Plot for Vrinda
episodesList.summary: For Vrinda's sake, Hemant strikes a business deal with Karthik. He and Dev scheme to bring Vrinda and Karthik closer, hoping for their reconciliation.

episodesList.title: AV Steals Vrinda's Credit
episodesList.summary: Vrinda is shocked to hear AV singing her song on the FM that she wrote online. When she demands credit, her voice is drowned out as everyone turns against her and blindly supports AV.

episodesList.title: Hrithik's Thankful Heart with Munni
episodesList.summary: Grateful for Munni's unwavering support, Hrithik finds solace in her understanding. Hemant's frustration boils over as he's seated with Noina at the business table.

episodesList.title: Karthik's Secret Attraction
episodesList.summary: As Karthik pampers Aarav and steals glances at Vrinda, he begins falling for her. Meanwhile, Munni teaches Timsi an important lesson in kindness after she misbehaves with a waiter.

episodesList.title: Timsi Praises Munni
episodesList.summary: Timsi opens up to Vrinda about feeling grateful to have Munni as her mother. As the business meeting falls flat, Karthik joins everyone in a dance to lift the mood.

episodesList.title: Mitali Insults Vrinda
episodesList.summary: AV faces questions about stealing song lyrics in an interview. Mitali accuses Vrinda of cheating on Angad and poisons Karthik's mind against Vrinda's family.

episodesList.title: Vikas Seeks Angad's Truth
episodesList.summary: Angad reads an online poem written by Vrinda, unaware of its author. Meanwhile, Vikas urges Angad to reveal his true identity instead of hiding behind the masked AV persona.

episodesList.title: Vrinda's New Assignment
episodesList.summary: Vrinda is asked to accompany Karthik to Delhi for a business meeting, while Mitali lures Dev into turning against Vrinda. Vikas insists Angad head to Delhi for his concert.

episodesList.title: Vrinda, Angad Cross Paths
episodesList.summary: Vrinda leaves for Delhi with Karthik after arranging donations for an orphanage. At the hotel, she unknowingly returns Angad's lost bracelet as they stay under the same roof.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Is Annoyed by AV's Music
episodesList.summary: Madhavi tells Timsi that Vrinda deserves better than Karthik. Elsewhere, Vrinda discovers AV is staying in the room next to hers and leaves him a note slamming his music.

episodesList.title: Karthik Gets Love Advice
episodesList.summary: Unaware of each other's connection to Vrinda, Angad encourages Karthik to confess his love at AV's concert. Meanwhile, Karthik plans to accompany Vrinda to the NGO.

episodesList.title: Karthik Proposes Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Dev and Mitali discuss the scheme they carried out against Vrinda. At AV's concert, Karthik proposes to Vrinda, but tension rises as the police arrive to arrest Vrinda.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Lands Behind Bars
episodesList.summary: Vrinda is arrested on money laundering charges, leaving the Virani family shocked. While Hemant stands by her, Noina forces Karthik to choose between her and the Viranis.

episodesList.title: Hemant Seeks Noina's Help
episodesList.summary: Noina agrees to help Hemant examine the accounts to trace the scammer. Mitali taunts Vrinda in jail, while Angad misses Vrinda and senses her presence around him.

episodesList.title: Karthik Proves Vrinda's Innocence
episodesList.summary: The Viranis await Vrinda's court hearing as Hemant and Noina fail to find any evidence. Meanwhile, Karthik uncovers crucial proof, secures Vrinda's release, and brings her home.

episodesList.title: Vrinda accepts Karthik's Proposal
episodesList.summary: Urged by her family, Vrinda accepts Karthik's proposal for the sake of her children. As the Viranis prepare for their engagement, Angad silently struggles with his emotions.

episodesList.title: Vrinda's Emotional Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Karthik invites Mitali to his engagement, leaving her stunned. As the families prepare for the ceremony, Vrinda struggles to move on from Angad and embrace her new future.

episodesList.title: Angad Shocks the Viranis
episodesList.summary: Vrinda and Karthik's engagement takes a dramatic turn when Angad arrives unexpectedly and reveals his identity. His sudden appearance leaves everyone stunned and Vrinda furious.

episodesList.title: Aarav's Request to AV
episodesList.summary: Angad struggles to hide his emotions as memories of Vrinda overwhelm him. Meanwhile, Aarav requests AV to stay and sing a song for the celebration.

episodesList.title: Karthik and Vrinda's Engagement
episodesList.summary: Angad is heartbroken as he watches Vrinda and Karthik exchange rings at the engagement. Sensing Vrinda's sadness, Karthik gently asks what's troubling her and offers comfort.

episodesList.title: Karthik Comforts Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Karthik comforts Vrinda as she admits she cannot move on from Angad. Later, Vrinda accuses AV of stealing the lyrics and using it under his name for the concert.

episodesList.title: Akshay Opens Up to AV
episodesList.summary: Gopu's words leave Akshay worried about losing Vrinda after her marriage to Karthik. Later, Akshay tells AV about the happy family he once had with Vrinda, Angad and Madhavi.

episodesList.title: Karthik's Offer to AV
episodesList.summary: As Vrinda struggles to move on after her engagement, Angad silently reads her emotional post. Soon, Karthik plans to sign AV as the company's international brand ambassador.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Stands by AV in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Vrinda defends AV amid public protests over the alleged theft of lyrics. Meanwhile, Noina opposes Karthik's decision to appoint AV as his company's brand ambassador.

episodesList.title: AV Signs Karthik's Contract
episodesList.summary: Hemant schemes to exploit AV's unyielding honesty for their latest brand strategy. Binding his fate to Karthik's empire, AV signs the fateful ambassador contract.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Suspects AV Is Angad
episodesList.summary: After chatting with AV online, Vrinda grows suspicious when his actions remind her of Angad. Her doubts intensify when she notices familiar traits and follows him.

episodesList.title: Mitali's Strategy Fails
episodesList.summary: Vrinda is stunned to learn that AV isn't Angad, while Mitali tries to turn Karthik against her. Later, Vrinda comforts Akshay after his exam is cancelled.

episodesList.title: Viranis Panic Over Missing Kids
episodesList.summary: The Viranis panic when Akshay, Madhavi and Timsi go missing, unaware that they are at a college protest. Meanwhile, the family searches nearby and contacts their friends.

episodesList.title: AV Admires Akshay
episodesList.summary: Akshay opens up to AV about his sacrifices, gaining heartfelt appreciation. As protests spiral into chaos, Vrinda frantically searches for Akshay, Madhavi, and Timsy.

episodesList.title: Vrinda, Angad Chat Anonymously
episodesList.summary: Vrinda and Angad talk online using different names, unaware of each other's identities. Later, Saloni grows concerned as Vrinda becomes overprotective of Aarav.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Brings AV Just in Time
episodesList.summary: Vrinda brings AV to the press conference, raising questions about how she found him. As Angad thanks her for saving the day, they get trapped together in a lift.

episodesList.title: Karthik Confronts the Media
episodesList.summary: Karthik fumes at the media for spreading rumors about AV and Vrinda's relationship. Angad apologises on Karthik's behalf and manages to control the situation.

episodesList.title: Angad Sets Out to Expose Karthik
episodesList.summary: Angad grows suspicious of Karthik and decides to expose his true intentions to Vrinda. Meanwhile, Saloni confronts Vrinda for making her insecure about Aarav's upbringing.

title: Sanai Chaughade
summary: Sanai Chaughade (transl. Wedding Bells) is an Indian Marathi language TV series which premiered from 16 March 2026 airing on Zee Marathi. It features Raj Hanchnale and Chinmayee Salvi in lead roles. The show is produced by Raju Sawant under the banner of One Day Creations. The series is an official remake of Zee Telugu's TV series Varudhini Parinayam.
plot: Jay Khanolkar, a highly disciplined businessman emotionally guarded by his parents' broken marriage, and Sharvari Parab, a fierce, strong-willed college graduate who fiercely guards her identity and traditional values. Hailing from entirely different socio-economic backgrounds and possessing contrasting personalities, the two are at constant loggerheads as their families’ paths intertwine due to their siblings Gautam and Asavari fall in love. Their intense clash of egos and ideals creates a simmer of emotional friction, pushing both to their limits. However, as they navigate underlying vulnerabilities, domestic duties, and societal pressure, destiny forces them into close proximity, gradually turning their initial animosity into an unexpected romance.

title: Andha Pyaar 2.0
summary: Andha Pyar 2.0 – Wingman Edition is an Indian Hindi-language reality dating series that premiered on ZEE5 on 14 March 2026. Created by comedians Vivek Samtani and Kaustubh Agarwal, the show is a social experiment focusing on blind dating where physical appearance is removed from the initial selection process.

articleSections.title: Format
articleSections.text:
The series revolves around the concept of finding love through personality and conversation rather than visual attraction. In each episode, a female protagonist interacts with four potential suitors while wearing a blindfold.
The show is distinguished by its comedic commentary. Creators Vivek Samtani and Kaustubh Agarwal serve as wingmen, guiding the participants through various rounds of questioning and vibe checks. A panel of guest comedians, including Harsh Gujral and Gaurav Kapoor, provides a meta-commentary on the proceedings, often joking about the contestants' red flags and awkward interactions.

articleSections.title: Hosts
articleSections.text: Vivek Samtani: stand-up comedian and co-creator. * Kaustubh Agarwal: stand-up comedian and co-creator.

articleSections.title: Regular panelists
articleSections.text: Harsh Gujral * Gaurav Kapoor * Gurleen Pannu * Onkar Yadav * Shreya Priyam Roy * Pranav Sharma * Rajat Sood * Chirag Panjwani * Javed Khan * Aaditya Kulshreshtha

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: In early 2026, ZEE5 announced the 2.0 version as part of its expansion into Gen Z-centric non-fiction content. The show was produced by Baneet Chhabra and directed by Ashish Bajaj.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The series began streaming on 14 March 2026, with episodes released weekly.

episodesList.title: Fun-Jabi Matchmakers
episodesList.summary: Gaurav Kapoor and Gurleen Pannu join the panel with their chaotic Punjabi matchmaking energy. At the center of it all is Khyaati Sharma. Will she find love or be betrayed for money?

episodesList.summary: Harsh Gujral joins Team Vivek with his signature roast as wingman, while Rajat Sood, in Team Kaustubh, steps in with soothing shayaris. In the middle is Maira, with her expectations to find love.

episodesList.summary: Raghu and Rajiv, from the Roadies fame, join Team Vivek and Kaustubh as the roasts get savage. In the middle is Nabeera, with her list of bare minimums, in love. Will the boys qualify?

episodesList.title: Harsh Gujral and Rahul Dua Roast Their Teammates
episodesList.summary: Harsh Gujral joins Team Kaustubh Agarwal, while Rahul Dua backs Team Vivek Samtani, and they roast their own teammates. Will Shobhika Bali find her perfect gym partner, or will money win the game?

episodesList.title: Gaurav in Focus, Onkar Takes Note
episodesList.summary: While Onkar brings newly‑wed glow to Team Kaustubh, Gaurav adds charm to Team Vivek. At the centre is Deeksha, nursing past heartbreaks. As equations shift, will she find love or chase the prize?

episodesList.title: Did Gaurav and Kushagra Call Their Team Average?
episodesList.summary: With Gaurav Kapoor's West Delhi wit and Kushagra's sharp roasts, the game heats up as Ankita searches for real emotional connection. As banter sharpens and loyalties wobble, will love win or money?

episodesList.title: Can Shreya and Onkar Fix Manya Destiny?
episodesList.summary: Real-life couple Onkar Yadav and Shreya Priyam Roy join the panel, backing rival matches for Manya. As sparks fly, the big question remains, will romance win or will money flip the game again?

episodesList.title: Chirag Panjwani vs Pranav Sharma, Love or Roast?
episodesList.summary: Chirag Panjwani joins Team Kaustubh and Pranav Sharma backs Team Vivek, turning the panel into a comedy warzone. With Mahima at the centre, will emotions triumph or will it all become content?

episodesList.title: OG Roadies vs Gen Z Love : Cupid Ya Chaos?
episodesList.summary: When OGs Raghu and Rajiv enter, sparks are inevitable. Caught between old-school instincts and Gen Z ideals is a romantic and bold Deeksha with the ultimate question, connection or cash?

title: Local Times
summary:
Local Times is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language workplace comedy-drama streaming television series created by Abbhinav Kastura and Praveen Muthurangan for Amazon Prime Video. Directed by Naveen George Thomas in his directorial debut, the series stars Rishikanth, Abdool Lee, Adwitha Arumugam, Maurish Dass, R. Pandiarajan, and Chinni Jayanth.
The series centers on a struggling local newspaper and follows four friends managing the publication.
plot:
The story revolves around Namma Seidhi, a once-respected regional weekly newspaper founded by the grandfather of Veera. In a landscape dominated by instant digital media and social media trends, the publication is on the verge of financial collapse, surviving primarily on the hope and grit of its small team.
Veera, driven by a sense of legacy, works alongside his best friend Azhagu, the resourceful Valli, and a dedicated intern, Muthu. Rather than hard-hitting investigative journalism, the team's daily routine often involves the more mundane struggles of news-gathering, securing local advertisements, managing mounting debts, and navigating petty office politics.
reception:
The series received generally positive reviews, with critics describing it as a light-hearted and feel-good watch. The Times of India noted that while the script relied on "contrived writing," the performances and "core friendship" made it an engaging "time-pass" watch.
Writing for The Hollywood Reporter India, Vishal Menon characterized the show as "basic background viewing pleasure," citing the relatable setting and likeable characters.
Scroll.in found the show's focus was on character-driven humor rather than the mechanics of journalism, remarking that "low on news-gathering and high on joke-gathering."
Cinema Express gave a negative review in which M Narayani stated ..."the screenplay starts to shred apart due to the lack of a novel premise. The comedy sequences too offer no respite from the drab scenes, and every time a character tries to break into a joke or two, the results lie somewhere in between eye-roll-inducing and something as old as the 2000s"
